prompts.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Create ONE full resolution landscape 1536x1024 native exercise master, not collage. Image1 canonical athlete identity: same bald faceless white anatomical figure fine contours visible leg anatomy smooth neutral pelvis without garments seams or genital detail, same white trainers. Black background. TRICEP KICKBACK with ONE dumbbell bench-supported exact variation. Side three-quarter view of athlete facing LEFT: left hand and left knee supported firmly on a horizontal dark charcoal flat bench, right white shoe planted on floor, right side nearest camera. Torso hinged nearly parallel to floor, spine long neutral head. RIGHT upper arm held horizontal beside torso with elbow behind shoulder at hip height; right elbow flexed 90 degrees, forearm hanging vertically downward holding one small dark round dumbbell with neutral hammer grip. Left supporting arm straight attached to pad. Show whole bench athlete and shoe with margin on right for straightening working forearm backward. RIGHT triceps strongest purple, rear deltoid light lilac, subtle core pale; rest neutral white anatomy. Fixed equipment plausible modest dumbbell two equal round heads, no text arrows logo. Make elbow and grip unambiguous.
